data.one_liner: A dio interceptor for automatic token refresh and authentication management.
data.what_it_does: Fresh is an HTTP interceptor built on top of package:dio that manages authentication tokens transparently. It automatically refreshes expired tokens, attaches auth headers, handles 401 errors by retrying requests, and provides an authentication status stream.
use_when: You are using dio for networking and need automatic token refresh on 401 responses.
You need single-flight request queuing during token refresh.
You want to react to authentication status changes via a stream.
avoid_when: You are not using package:dio for your networking layer.
strengths: Automatic token refresh and proactive refreshing before requests
Single-flight refresh prevents duplicate concurrent refresh calls
Pluggable token storage and custom token formats supported
